en: Colorized panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. The foreground shows dense rows of multi‑story buildings with light façades and grey roofs, interspersed with trees. A prominent church with a steep roof and tall spire stands near the center. In the background, houses are scattered up the hillsides under a pastel evening or morning sky. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the town and view direction, along with the publisher information in smaller red text.
